text.hi: किताब की तालिका में आशु के बारे में लिखा है: 1998 में स्कूल आया, क्रिकेट, नीला रंग, विज्ञान, केला, 14 नवंबर 1993। इससे वाक्य बनाओ।
text.hinglish: Kitaab ki taalika mein Ashu ke baare mein likha hai: 1998 mein school aaya, cricket, neela rang, vigyaan, kela, 14 November 1993. Isse vaakya banao.
text.en: The book's table says about Ashu: joined in 1998, cricket, blue, science, banana, 14th November 1993. Make sentences from it.

steps.answer: Ashu joined the school in the year 1998.

meaning.hi: आशु ने 1998 में स्कूल में दाख़िला लिया।
meaning.hinglish: Ashu ne 1998 mein school mein daakhila liya.

text.hi: किताब का दूसरा सवाल: दोस्त को स्कूल के खेल-कूद के बारे में चिट्ठी। ढाँचा: (ऊपर दाईं ओर) तुम्हारा पता और तारीख़। Dear Rahul, I hope you are fine. Last week our school held its Sports Day. ... I won the 100 metre race! ... With love, (तुम्हारा नाम)।
text.hinglish: Kitaab ka doosra sawaal: dost ko school ke khel-kood ke baare mein chitthi. Dhaancha: (upar daayin or) tumhara pata aur taareekh. Dear Rahul, I hope you are fine. Last week our school held its Sports Day. ... I won the 100 metre race! ... With love, (tumhara naam).
text.en: The book's second task: a letter to a friend about a sports event at school. Format: your address and the date at the top right. Dear Rahul, I hope you are fine. Last week our school held its Sports Day. ... I won the 100 metre race! ... With love, (your name).

prompt.hi: चिट्ठी की शुरुआत: मुझे उम्मीद है तुम ठीक हो।
prompt.hinglish: Chitthi ki shuruaat: mujhe ummeed hai tum theek ho.
prompt.en: Start of the letter: say you hope your friend is fine.

meaning.hi: मुझे उम्मीद है तुम ठीक हो।
meaning.hinglish: Mujhe ummeed hai tum theek ho.

prompt.hi: चिट्ठी: पिछले हफ़्ते हमारे स्कूल में खेल दिवस हुआ।
prompt.hinglish: Chitthi: pichhle hafte hamare school mein khel diwas hua.
prompt.en: Letter: say your school held its Sports Day last week.

steps.answer: Last week our school held its Sports Day.

meaning.hi: पिछले हफ़्ते हमारे स्कूल में खेल दिवस हुआ।
meaning.hinglish: Pichhle hafte hamare school mein khel diwas hua.

prompt.hi: चिट्ठी: मैंने 100 मीटर की दौड़ जीती।
prompt.hinglish: Chitthi: maine 100 metre ki daud jeeti.
prompt.en: Letter: say you won the 100 metre race.

steps.question: How do we end a letter to a friend?

questionMeaning.hi: दोस्त को चिट्ठी कैसे ख़त्म करते हैं?
questionMeaning.hinglish: Dost ko chitthi kaise khatm karte hain?
